target_type_scope: o : ObservationOrientation (candidate type parameter); Applicability_x(o; D_rel) : Prop
target_type_guard: ObservationOrientation_x(D_rel) is candidate dependent-type notation only; no governed D_rel-indexed target type is assumed.
source_type_scope: X,Z : RT_OR_ART_TYPED_OPERAND, exact source declaration unresolved
source_context_scope: Y : SOURCE_COMPOSITION_CONTEXT, with mappings to B_x, D_rel, and R unresolved
governing_principle: Hypothesize an orientation-bearing aspect of a source operand; do not identify the source operand with an observation orientation.
threshold_independence_guard: Carrier-aspect existence is evaluated without D(X|Z) > epsilon_src.
Carrier-aspect relation to o is evaluated without d_obs(o_i,o_j) > epsilon_obs.
Threshold agreement may test a relation after construction but cannot establish the relation.
PASS/PASS is not evidence that a carrier mapping is valid.
FAIL/FAIL is not by itself evidence that a valid carrier mapping is absent.

support_result_types.meaning: UNDEFINED reflects missing type, dependency, applicability, or extractor evidence; it is not coerced to NO_ASPECT.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A pre-RefOrient aspect a_x extracted from the operand under D_rel.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: EvalExtractOrientAspect_x(X; D_rel) = EXTRACTED(a_x) AND RelateOrientAspect_x(a_x, o; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: The extractor returns EXTRACTED(a_x) and a governed relation relates a_x to o.
hypotheses.negative_condition: The extractor returns NO_ASPECT, or a governed aspect relation definitively rejects o. This rejects H1 mediation only.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: The extractor or relation returns UNDEFINED, or source type, target applicability, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed operand has the declared source type but complete pre-RefOrient analysis returns NO_ASPECT.
hypotheses.resolution_case: A previously undefined extractor or relation becomes governed and returns EXTRACTED or NO_ASPECT.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: The extractor and aspect relation are evaluated before source or observation distinction-floor comparison.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A source orientation-class field and separately typed observation-orientation class.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: SourceOrientClass_x(X) = c_src AND ObsOrientClass_x(o) = c_obs AND ClassBridge_x(c_src, c_obs; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: Both class fields and the class bridge are independently declared, applicable, and pre-RefOrient.
hypotheses.negative_condition: A governed class pair is rejected. This rejects H2 mediation only and does not establish global NOT_REPRESENTED.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: A class field, class bridge, applicability decision, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
context_dependencies: Y may index applicability but may not create the class bridge
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed source and target class pair exists, but the class bridge rejects compatibility before threshold evaluation.
hypotheses.resolution_case: The class fields or bridge become governed and resolve compatibility.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: Class compatibility is evaluated without either distinction-floor test.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: Absence of an orientation-bearing aspect or authorized class/projection bridge.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: NoOrientAspect_x(X; D_rel) AND NoApplicableCarrierRule_x(X, o; D_rel)
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; definiteness requires complete applicable-rule evidence.
hypotheses.negative_condition: A complete governed analysis establishes no aspect and no applicable authorized carrier rule.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Rule-set completeness, source typing, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is incomplete.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed aspect or authorized applicable carrier rule is found.
hypotheses.resolution_case: Complete rule-set evidence changes the current undefined status to definite non-relation.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: Non-relation is based on type/aspect/rule-set analysis, not threshold outcome.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: Potential orientation-bearing structure cannot be decided from current source declarations.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: CarrierRelation_x(X, o; Y, D_rel) = UNDEFINED when required type, aspect, target, rule, provenance, or stage evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable while required evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Not applicable; unresolved evidence is not coerced to NOT_REPRESENTED.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Any required source type, target type, rule set, authority, provenance, context mapping, or dependency completeness evidence is missing.
hypotheses.falsification_case: Not applicable to the unresolved-status classification; substantive H1/H2/H3 evidence resolves the case.
hypotheses.resolution_case: Complete governed evidence resolves the relation as represented or not represented.
hypotheses.threshold_independence_statement: Undefined status is assigned before threshold evaluation.

global_failure_guard: Failure of H1 or H2 alone does not establish global NOT_REPRESENTED; only H3 with complete applicable-rule-set evidence can support that result.
